summary: Verified prod hotfix for (1) intermittent login 500s and (2) slow lead search. Backend: 11/11 pytest passed covering admin/caller login, /auth/me, 10 sequential logins (no 500), case-insensitive prefix search (dha/Dha/DHA return identical sets), phone search, create-lead-then-search, PATCH name and confirm old prefix no longer matches, plus regression on default list/pipeline/ozonetel buckets and sort. Frontend smoke: admin login 200 → dashboard renders → Leads page → typing 'dha' + Enter fires GET /api/leads?search=dha&bucket=pipeline and returns exactly Dhananjay Rai. Search performance well under 1s in all cases.

issues: Leads search input does not auto-search on typing; user must press Enter to trigger the API call. Pre-existing behavior, not caused by this fix, but worth confirming with product — the top global-search-input has same behavior.

action_items: React console warning on Leads page: 'Encountered two children with the same key ... New / Unassigned' — duplicate React key when rendering lead stage list, should be de-duplicated.
critical_code_review_comments: update_lead correctly recomputes name_lc/contact_name_lc/email_lc from EDITABLE_FIELDS; verified by DB inspection after PATCH.
build_query search branch uses case-sensitive '^'+s.lower() regex on *_lc — good, will use index bounds.

Note: search matches email_lc as well as name_lc, so a lead whose email prefix equals its old name prefix can still surface under the old name prefix after a name change (data-shape edge case, not a bug).
seed_data_creation: Created 1 test lead via POST /api/leads (Yynewname64b0d6a5 Kumar, id 500178) and archived it via /lost. Total leads count 1,19,808 unchanged in UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix from iter52 (case-sensitive ^prefix regex on *_lc fields + maxPoolSize 100 + backfill) is verified working. If retesting search-related bugs, note that /api/leads search REQUIRES Enter in the leads-search-input (no debounce on typing) — Playwright must inp.press('Enter') to fire the request.
